scope: Source-only automatic FT daemon response identity inventory
facts: Response handler declares nonce pointer, assigns pData and advances past eight nonce bytes; no equality comparison or request lookup in that body
Automatic key request event carries KeyInfo R1KHID/S1KHID and station MAC; current prepared peer stamp is not part of daemon request ABI
Native handler can wait on station completion under R1KH_HARD_RETRY; matching completion needs lifetime-safe admission while request is pending
required_contract: Establish what daemon echoes without changing wire ABI speculatively
Publish pending native request identity with generation/BSS before event submission
Retire pending identity on timeout, association change and teardown
Validate response against pending identity before retry-counter reset/completion
Preserve native completion progress while peer lease is held
